name: Qwen2.5-VL 7B (vision)
summary: A stronger local vision model for detailed analysis, for cards with 8 GB or more.
details: Alibaba’s Qwen2.5-VL in its 7-billion-parameter form (about 6 GB) reads pictures in more detail than the smaller models and is better at pointing out specific features. Needs a graphics card with about 8 GB or more. Runs in Ollama.

capabilities.label: Answers detailed questions about a picture

licence.name: Apache 2.0
licence.summary: Free to use and share, including commercially, with the licence notice kept.

verification.note: Atlas has not run this model.

instructions: Install Ollama from https://ollama.com, then press Install here (or run: ollama pull qwen2.5vl:7b).
Atlas can ask your own Ollama to download it (with your approval). Atlas cannot make a language model look at pictures unless the model is a vision model, as this one is.
